name: React Flow
description: Renders the reactflow widget type with React Flow: flow diagrams, decision trees, pipelines and architecture maps that the user can rearrange and the AI agent can read and rewrite.

widgets.name: Flow diagram
widgets.description: A diagram of nodes and the edges between them, laid out automatically, which the user can move, connect, rename and extend

response.description: The diagram as {"nodes": [...], "edges": [...]}, with the optional keys title and direction. The endpoint gets theme=dark or theme=light.

artifact.description: A flow diagram: steps and the arrows between them, a decision tree, a pipeline or a map of systems. Use it when an order, a branch or a dependency reads better as boxes and arrows than as a list.

graph.title: Diagram
graph.description: The diagram as JSON: {"nodes": [...], "edges": [...]}. The widget writes this setting whenever the user changes the diagram, and the AI agent reads and sets it. Empty means the diagram the endpoint returns.

skills.description: How to draw and change a flow diagram with the React Flow component: the shape of the graph, which node shapes and colours to use, and how to edit a diagram that is already on a dashboard.
